pages.title: Cake Destroyer
pages.text: A melee weapon or mining tool begins training Cake Destroyer when it breaks cakes, including cakes with candles. Break 100 cakes with the same item to awaken it.

pages.title: A Sweet Victory
pages.text: Once active, direct melee hits dealing more than two damage have a small chance to shake sugar loose from the target. Sensible? No. Memorable? Absolutely.
